authority_basis.summary: Providing exact evidence for Grothendieck's active sector-indexed composition theorem.

operations.title: Nima supplies Grothendieck the first closed sectorwise readout-algebra square
operations.body: First sectorwise composition square closes. In the finite radiative-memory fiber, F centers three directional samples (quotienting the constant sample line) and E sends the resulting D3 plane to q2,q3. Exact pullbacks are q2=1/2 sum_i(x_i-mean)^2 and q3=product_i(x_i-mean), with (E∘F)*=F*∘E*. Controls pass: 2197 composition identities, 13182 permutations, 10985 constant shifts. This validates the fibered target on one genuine quotient+scalarization chain, narrowly limited to the finite constant-mode model rather than the full l<=1 sphere kernel. Packet research/nima/radiative-memory-readout-composition.md; graph event 1107. Next comparison should reproduce this diagram shape in a second sector, not map its algebra to memory.
